chapters.title: Arriving & Seating
lines: Good evening. Do you have a table for two?
No, we don't. Is there a table available?
Would you like to sit inside or outside?
Outside, please. It's a nice evening.
Could we have a table by the window?
می‌توانیم میز کنار پنجره داشته باشیم؟
Of course. Here are the menus.
Thank you. We'll need a few minutes.
ممنون. چند دقیقه وقت لازم داریم.

chapters.title: Ordering
lines: The grilled salmon is very popular.
ماهی سالمون کبابی خیلی محبوب است.
I'd like the chicken with rice.
Does it come with a salad?
Yes, it comes with a side salad.
بله، با یک سالاد کنار سرو می‌شود.
I'm allergic to nuts. Does this dish have any?
به آجیل حساسیت دارم. این غذا آجیل دارد؟
No, it doesn't. It's safe for you.
نه، ندارد. برای شما مشکلی ندارد.

chapters.title: Drinks & Eating
lines: What would you like to drink?
I'll have a glass of orange juice.
Could I have some more bread?
می‌توانم کمی نان بیشتر داشته باشم؟
Excuse me, could we have another fork?
ببخشید، می‌توانیم یک چنگال دیگر داشته باشیم؟

chapters.title: Problems
lines: Excuse me, this isn't what I ordered.
ببخشید، این چیزی نیست که سفارش دادم.
I'm very sorry. I'll change it right away.
خیلی متأسفم. همین الان عوضش می‌کنم.
I'll bring you a hot one.
We've been waiting for a long time.
Could you pack the leftovers for me?
می‌توانید باقی‌مانده‌ی غذا را برایم بسته‌بندی کنید؟
Could we see the dessert menu?

chapters.title: Paying
lines: Could we have the bill, please?
I think there's a mistake on the bill.
Thank you for coming. Have a nice evening!
ممنون که آمدید. شب خوبی داشته باشید!
